sources.snippet: Output: Sample Images from the MNIST Training Dataset Loading MNIST dataset Using PyTorch This code shows how to load the MNIST handwritten digit dataset using PyTorch and visualize a few sample images. It helps in understanding how images and labels are accessed through a DataLoader before training a model. Imports required libraries for data loading, tensor transformation and visualization ...
